text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":8,"unit":"sapphires","kind":"count","span":"starts out with 8 sapphires"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"sapphires","kind":"count","span":"trades 3 sapphires"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"rubies","kind":"count","span":"for two rubies"},{"id":"q4","value":800,"unit":"dollars","kind":"money","span":"sapphires are worth $800"},{"id":"q5","value":1200,"unit":"dollars","kind":"money","span":"rubies are worth $1200"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"starting sapphires minus the 3 traded away gives remaining sapphires"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"remaining sapphires times value per sapphire gives sapphire worth"},{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q5"],"out":"s3","note":"rubies received times value per ruby gives ruby worth"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"sapphire worth plus ruby worth gives total value of her jewels"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"total value of all Jenna's jewels"},"dismissed":[]}
